mapper.sql: c.id, c.article_id, c.parent_id, c.author_id, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) as author_name, c.body, c.status, c.deleted_by, c.deleted_time, c.create_time, (select count(*) from nad_article_comment_like l where l.comment_id = c.id) as like_count
mapper.insert: insert into nad_article_comment (article_id, parent_id, author_id, body, status, create_time) values (#{articleId}, #{parentId}, #{authorId}, #{body}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: select from nad_article_comment c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.author_id where c.article_id = #{articleId} order by c.create_time asc, c.id asc
select count(*) from nad_article_comment where author_id = #{authorId} and create_time >= #{since}
mapper.update: update nad_article_comment set status = 'DELETED', deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'VISIBLE'
update nad_article_comment set status = 'DELETED', deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_time = now() where author_id = #{authorId} and status = 'VISIBLE'
